examples: See which account still has room before starting a long task.
Spread work across a personal and a work account so neither runs out.
On a phone the page is one bar: the back arrow at the left, the title over the search in one frame, the filters that fit and one grid/list flip at the right.
how_to: Add each claude or codex account you use on the ledger screen.
Read each account's five hour and weekly usage and when they reset; the pick badge marks the account to use next.
The drawer panel's chevron cycles compact, expanded and hidden.
Edit an account to change its name, its short name (shown where the full name will not fit) and its colour; the colour picker shows 249 distinct swatches from the 256 xterm indexes, plus a hex field.
The colour picker stays above surrounding panels while you choose a swatch, and Escape closes it.
Press the (i) at the top of the providers screen to read how account keep-alive works and what to do when an account shows login revoked.

On the Providers screen the strip on top ranks every account by its tightest window (read-only; the cards below never re-order). Each card shows its status in the title strip, usage as big percents with a meter, and plan, managed or built-in, fetched time and the switch control in the footer.
